title: Estimating worst case frontier risks of open weight LLMs
summary: In this paper, we study the worst-case frontier risks of releasing gpt-oss. We introduce malicious fine-tuning (MFT), where we attempt to elicit maximum capabilities by fine-tuning gpt-oss to be as capable as possible in two domains: biology and cybersecurity.
body: In this paper, we study the worst-case frontier risks of releasing gpt-oss. We introduce malicious fine-tuning (MFT), where we attempt to elicit maximum capabilities by fine-tuning gpt-oss to be as capable as possible in two domains: biology and cybersecurity.
summaryZh: 该研究探讨了开源模型gpt-oss在极端情况下的前沿风险，重点引入了“恶意微调（MFT）”概念。研究通过在生物学和网络安全领域对模型进行极限微调，评估其被滥用的潜在能力。这一分析为开源模型发布的安全评估提供了重要参考，揭示了在开放权重模式下，如何平衡技术普及与安全防范之间的矛盾，是AI安全领域的重要学术贡献。
